name: Glarity - Summary for Google/YouTube with ChatGPT
summary: An open-source extension that shows AI-generated summaries next to Google search results and on YouTube videos. It can also summarise other web pages, PDFs and emails, and adds side-by-side translation and web content Q&A.
audience: Readers and researchers who want quick summaries of search results, videos and long web pages.
pros: Summaries on Google, YouTube, Bing, GitHub and many other sites
Also does side-by-side translation and email writing help
Open source, with a Firefox version as well
cons: Needs access to an AI service such as the OpenAI API or a ChatGPT Plus account
Page and video content is sent to a third-party AI service to produce summaries
